name: Jean-Marie Le Pen
role: Founder and president of the French National Front (1972–2011), presidential candidate and member of the European Parliament
summary: Jean-Marie Le Pen led the French National Front for four decades. His programmes call for ending immigration and family reunification, reserving welfare and nationality for French citizens, restoring the death penalty, leaving NATO and Schengen, rejecting EU supranational powers, protectionism, school vouchers, nuclear energy and referendums, while opposing gay marriage and abortion.
